description: This file is a wrapper script for the compiler (clang) used in a cross-compilation environment. It processes command-line options to adjust library paths and invoke the real compiler, as well as functions for handling library paths and symbol replacement within binary files.

methods.name: parse_option
methods.description: Parses command-line options to categorize libraries, directories, output file, and rpaths.

methods.name: get_library_path
methods.description: Finds the path of a specified library in provided library directories.

methods.name: get_realpath
methods.description: Determines the real path of a library or binary, handling mangled names and symlinks.

methods.name: get_otool_path
methods.description: Obtains the path of a library relative to the workspace for use in binary modifications.
